stories.title: Ce que l’on sait du projet d’attaque présumé contre une base militaire en Angleterre

en.title: What is known about the alleged attack plot against a military base in England
en.summary: Five people arrested near a British military base used by the US military on suspicion of preparing a terrorist act were released on bail. Counterterrorism police are investigating multiple leads, including possible involvement by a foreign state, while Iran denies any involvement.

stories.title: Figure des difficultés des locataires madrilènes, Maricarmen Abascal peut rentrer chez elle

en.title: An 87-year-old evicted tenant, Maricarmen Abascal, can return to her Madrid home
en.summary: An 87-year-old retiree who was evicted from her Madrid apartment has reached an agreement with her landlords allowing her to return home. Her case sparked widespread protests in Spain.

stories.title: En exil après avoir été renversé, Umaro Sissoco Embalo se déclare candidat à la présidentielle de Guinée-Bissau

en.title: In exile after being overthrown, Umaro Sissoco Embalo declares his candidacy for Guinea-Bissau's presidential election
en.summary: The former president of Guinea-Bissau, ousted in a military coup ten months ago, has announced his candidacy for the December 6 presidential election intended to restore constitutional order. He currently remains in exile.

stories.title: Krieg in der Ukraine – Russische Drohnenangriffe im Stadtzentrum von Kiew

en.title: War in Ukraine – Russian drone attacks in central Kyiv
en.summary: A Russian drone attack set fire to the historic building of the Academy of Sciences and a clinic in downtown Kyiv. No further details are provided.

stories.title: En Espagne, la retraitée madrilène expulsée va pouvoir regagner son logement

en.title: In Spain, retired Madrid woman facing eviction will be able to return to her home
en.summary: An 87-year-old Spanish retiree whose eviction from her Madrid apartment triggered national protests over the country's housing crisis has reached an agreement with the property owners allowing her to return.

stories.title: Italien und Frankreich gewinnen in der Nations League

en.title: Italy and France win in the Nations League
en.summary: Italy defeated Turkey 4-1 in the Nations League, marking Roberto Mancini's first victory since returning as Italy's national coach, while France also won with Michael Olise performing well.

stories.title: Nations League: Round-up – Zidane wechselt den späten Sieg ein – Italien mit Gala

en.title: Nations League: Round-up – Zidane secures late victory – Italy puts on a display
en.summary: France achieved a 1-0 victory in Belgium in the Nations League while Italy dominated Turkey in their match.

stories.title: A Yverdon-les-Bains puis à Lausanne, Stéphane Blok livrera ses sérénades pour un monde malade

en.title: In Yverdon-les-Bains and then in Lausanne, Stéphane Blok will perform his serenades for a sick world
en.summary: Lausanne-based poet and musician Stéphane Blok returns to protest songs with the album "City 8047", featuring ten songs addressing capitalist and technological excesses.

stories.title: En Suède, la cheffe des sociaux-démocrates échoue à former un gouvernement

en.title: In Sweden, the Social Democrats leader fails to form a government
en.summary: Magdalena Andersson, whose Social Democratic party won September legislative elections, was unable to build a coalition with centrist and far-left parties. Conservative incumbent Ulf Kristersson may now have the opportunity to form a government.

stories.title: Les suspects du projet d'attentat contre la base militaire de Fairford libérés sous caution

en.title: Suspects in alleged attack plot against Fairford military base released on bail
en.summary: Five men suspected of preparing an explosive attack in England were released on bail after interrogation. They were arrested near a U.S. air base used for operations against Iran; Tehran denies involvement.

stories.title: Après leur victoire en Suède, les sociaux-démocrates échouent à former un gouvernement

en.title: After their victory in Sweden, Social Democrats fail to form a government
en.summary: Magdalena Andersson, whose Social Democratic party won the September elections, announced failure in forming a government. Conservative Ulf Kristersson may now be tasked with government formation.

stories.title: Chantal Quéhen célèbre la beauté fragile du monde végétal à Yverdon-les-Bains

en.title: Chantal Quéhen celebrates the fragile beauty of the plant world in Yverdon-les-Bains
en.summary: Inspired by childhood gardens in Pas-de-Calais, artist Chantal Quéhen creates works from leaves, flowers, and petals. Her exhibition runs at Pro Natura's Champ-Pittet Centre through November 1st.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Foie gras statt Freihandel: Hinter der grossen Trump-Xi-Show lauert schon der nächste Handelsstreit

en.title: COMMENTARY - Foie gras instead of free trade: The next trade dispute is already lurking behind the grand Trump-Xi show
en.summary: A summit meeting in Washington between the leaders of the world's two largest economies has done little to resolve major differences between the United States and China.

stories.title: UBS-Aktie auf 18-Jahre-Hoch: Die Anleger lassen sich vom Streit um das Eigenkapital nicht abschrecken

en.title: UBS share reaches 18-year high: investors unmoved by capital dispute
en.summary: UBS shares hit an 18-year high despite an ongoing dispute between the Swiss Federal Council and the bank over capital requirements. Analysts remain unconcerned about the disagreement and speculation regarding the bank's potential relocation.

stories.title: MELDUNGEN WIRTSCHAFT - Biontech schliesst drei Werke in Deutschland +++ Wäschehersteller Calida plant Aktienrückkauf und höhere Dividenden

en.title: BUSINESS BRIEFS - Biontech closes three German plants +++ Laundry manufacturer Calida plans share buyback and higher dividends
en.summary: Biontech is closing three facilities in Germany, while textile company Calida announced plans for a share repurchase program and dividend increases.

stories.title: Rasierapparate, Kamele und Hasenfell: Die USA und China wollen die Zölle auf wenige ausgewählte Produkte reduzieren

en.title: Razors, camels and rabbit fur: The USA and China want to reduce tariffs on a few selected products
en.summary: Donald Trump and Xi Jinping achieved only a minimal consensus at their recent summit, with major issues deferred for later discussion.

stories.title: INTERVIEW - «Das Image ist etwas verstaubt», sagt der CEO Thomas Stöcklin über das kriselnde Geschäft beim Pyjama-Verkäufer Calida

en.title: INTERVIEW - "The image is somewhat outdated," says CEO Thomas Stöcklin about struggling pajama retailer Calida
en.summary: Calida has faced difficult years following costly acquisitions and disappointing results, but the board has now decided to increase dividend payments, according to the CEO.
